title: Scientists discover how deep sleep builds muscle, burns fat, and boosts the brain
caption:
Deep sleep does more than just rebuild muscle tissue and burn fat. Neuroscientists mapped the brain circuit controlling growth hormone and discovered a two-way loop that directly regulates morning alertness.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover how deep sleep builds muscle, burns fat, and boosts the brain
